en.title: Is there snow in Montenegro? Snow depth and new snow on 17 November 2026
en.description: Montenegro snow today, 17 November: snow cover, new snow, snow depth by height, the next days and the best resorts.
en.lede: The white area in Montenegro stands at about 20 km² today, 60 km² lost since yesterday.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: Below about 2,200 m the slopes are mostly green or brown. Seven days ago the figure was 280 km², 260 km² more than now.
The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 0 cm anywhere.
The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.
Climb and the snow gets deeper: 2,000-2,500 m: on average 1 cm (15 % of the ground white).
The week ahead could bring up to 15 cm, 1 cm of it in the next three days.
Monday 23 November stands out, with up to 9 cm in a day.
The deepest snow of the country's resorts is at Ski centar Savin kuk: 15 cm.
Ski centar Savin kuk picked up 10 cm in the last three days and could add 5 cm by Friday 20 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 1 out of 3 resorts in Montenegro.

advice: Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Snow above the tree line can be wind-packed: watch the ridges.

cnr.title: Koliko snijega ima u Crnoj Gori? Snježni pokrivač i prognoza, 17. novembra 2026.
cnr.description: Snijeg u Crnoj Gori 17. novembra: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
cnr.lede: Utorak, 17. novembra: snijeg pokriva oko 20 km² planina u Crnoj Gori. To je 60 km² manje nego jučer.

p: Teren je pretežno bijel od oko 2.200 m naviše. Prije sedam dana bilo je 280 km²: od tada se otopilo 260 km².
Posljednja tri dana gotovo nije padao snijeg: maksimum je 0 cm.
Otopljenje topi pokrivač: ujutro tvrd snijeg, poslijepodne mokar.
Visina snijega zavisi od nadmorske visine: 2.000–2.500 m: prosječno 1 cm (15 % pod snijegom).
Prognoza novog snijega: do 1 cm za tri dana i do 15 cm za sedam dana.
Najsnježniji dan: ponedjeljak, 23. novembra, do 9 cm.
Prednjači Ski centar Savin kuk: 15 cm na gornjem dijelu staza.

advice: Prije polaska provjerite rade li liftovi.
